sd_panel_author_sub: Interactive Guides, Timelines & Core System Info
sd_guide_s1_desc: When you first open Sanctuary OS, it finds your game folders and automatically reads your exact game patch version right from your game's .exe file.
sd_guide_s1_c1_desc: Where your game executable (like TS4_x64.exe) lives. Sanctuary reads the exact patch version directly from the .exe so you always know if your mods match your patch!
sd_guide_s1_c2_desc: Your game's Mods folder. You never need to drag files into Electronic Arts/Mods manually—Sanctuary links your active Play Set into this folder automatically.
sd_guide_s1_c3_desc: A safe folder where all your mods, CC, Play Sets, and Save Backups are stored neatly where game updates can never mess them up.
sd_guide_s1_c4_desc: Turn on Windows Developer Mode (or run Sanctuary OS as Administrator) so Sanctuary can create instant 0-byte smart links instead of copying files.
sd_guide_s1_tip: Click the Cloud Auto-Detect button during setup to find your Sims 4 Bin and Mods folders automatically!
sd_guide_s2_desc: Your main dashboard gives you an instant look at whether your current Play Set is ready to play, needs mod updates, or has any broken mods.
sd_guide_s2_c1_desc: All enabled mods in your Play Set match your game patch, have their required packs/mods installed, and have zero conflicts!
sd_guide_s2_c2_desc: One or more of your installed mods has a newer version available from the creator!
sd_guide_s2_c3_desc: A mod is marked Unstable after a game patch or two mods have a soft tuning overlap where you should pick which one wins.
sd_guide_s2_c4_desc: An enabled mod is confirmed broken, outdated for your patch, missing a required pack/mod, or clashing with another mod.
sd_guide_s2_tip: Use the bottom status bar anytime to run a quick Mod Scan or temporarily disable all mods in one click!
sd_guide_s3_desc: Your Library holds all your mods and CC safely outside the game folder, checks their SHA-256 fingerprint, and links only the ones you turn on into the game.
sd_guide_s3_c1_desc: Drop .package, .ts4script, .zip, .rar, or .7z files anywhere into the app! If you already have the exact same file, Sanctuary catches the duplicate right away.
sd_guide_s3_c2_desc: When a creator includes an override.json file in their download, Sanctuary connects it so you get automatic update alerts and mod rules straight from the creator!
sd_guide_s3_c3_desc: If you try to remove a core mod (like XML Injector) that your other mods need, Sanctuary warns you and shows every dependent add-on first.
sd_guide_s3_c4_desc: Mods that are missing an Expansion Pack or outdated for your patch appear faded with a helpful tooltip explaining exactly what's missing.
sd_guide_s3_tip: You can customize any mod's display name, creator link, cover picture, and tags in your Library without affecting anyone else!
sd_guide_s4_desc: Create different Play Sets for different saves—like a Realistic Family play set, an Occult play set, or a Building-Only set—and swap between them in one click!
sd_guide_s4_c1_desc: Switch your active Play Set anytime from the Library header or Play Sets page without copying or moving gigabytes of CC.
sd_guide_s4_c2_desc: Share your favorite mod list with friends or across your own computers using a short 6-letter/number code.
sd_guide_s4_c3_desc: Export any Play Set as a .json file that remembers all your custom mod names and creator links even completely offline.
sd_guide_s4_c4_title: Build a Mod List on Your Phone
sd_guide_s4_c4_desc: Browse mods on your phone or tablet, save a queue to your account, and install it in one click when you're back at your PC!
sd_guide_s4_tip: Click 'Snapshot Active Play Set' before trying out a big batch of new CC so you can always switch right back!
sd_guide_s5_desc: Browse community Mods, Play Sets, Language Packs, Themes, and Config Templates—and grab downloads straight from creator pages with the built-in Side Browser.
sd_guide_s5_c1_desc: Automatically filters mods so you can see what works with your current game patch and the Expansion Packs you own.
sd_guide_s5_c2_desc: When you click download on a creator's page inside the built-in Side Browser, Sanctuary grabs the zip or package and installs it right into your Library!
sd_guide_s5_c3_desc: Follow your favorite CC & mod creators to see their updates in your feed. Sanctuary takes 0% of creator tips and links straight to their Patreon or Ko-fi.
sd_guide_s5_c4_desc: Found a new mod that isn't in the catalog yet? Submit its info to help other Simmers, or mark personal files as 'Local Only'.
sd_guide_s5_tip: Prefer using Chrome, Edge, or Firefox for downloads? You can toggle the built-in browser on or off anytime in Settings -> Network.
sd_guide_s6_desc: Finds mods that clash with each other before you launch the game and automatically sets up your Resource.cfg and override folders so the right mod wins.
sd_guide_s6_c1_desc: When two mods tune the same game setting (Severity 3), just click the one you want to win! Sanctuary handles the priority folders automatically.
sd_guide_s6_c2_desc: Want full control? Switch to Advanced Mode to create 'Must Load After / Before' rules, pick Priority Tiers, and fix circular loops in one click.
sd_guide_s6_c3_desc: Severity 4 means two mods cannot be used together at all. Severity 3 means they overlap slightly and you just pick which one loads last.
sd_guide_s6_c4_desc: Automatically uses the right load order style for each game—like Resource.cfg priority folders for The Sims 4 or loadorder.txt lists for other games.
sd_guide_s6_tip: You can switch between Casual Mode and Advanced Mode anytime at the top of the Conflict Finder!
sd_guide_s7_desc: Test a brand-new mod or check if two mods work together in a clean sandbox—while keeping your real Sims households 100% untouched!
sd_guide_s7_c1_desc: Temporarily unlinks your big mod folder and loads only the mod you're testing (plus any required core mods) so it boots fast and clean.
sd_guide_s7_c2_desc: Tucks your real Saves folder away safely and loads a dedicated Lab Test Save while testing, so your legacy families can never get messed up!
sd_guide_s7_c3_desc: Watches for LastException files and game crashes while you playtest and explains known error causes in plain English.
sd_guide_s7_c4_desc: Test two mods side-by-side to see if they play nicely together and share the results with community moderators.
sd_guide_s7_tip: When you finish a timed playtest in the Lab and save your game cleanly, your mod is automatically marked as verified!
sd_guide_s8_desc: Back up your Saves, Tray creations, and Game Files in seconds without wasting drive space, and tweak mod config files using easy sliders and toggles.
sd_guide_s8_c1_title: Saves & Tray Backups vs. Game File Backups
sd_guide_s8_c1_desc: Back up your Saves, Tray library, and options anytime—or back up your actual Game Installation files so you can roll back if a new patch breaks your mods!
sd_guide_s8_c2_title: 0 MB Extra Space for Unchanged Files
sd_guide_s8_c2_desc: Uses smart hardlinks so files that haven't changed since your last backup take up 0 MB of extra disk space!
sd_guide_s8_c3_title: Restore Everything or Just One Save Slot
sd_guide_s8_c3_desc: Roll back an entire backup in seconds, or peek inside any backup to pull out a single household save file.
sd_guide_s8_c4_desc: Edit mod .json/.cfg/.ini settings using friendly toggles and sliders instead of raw code—plus every Simmer gets local Creator Sandbox & IDE tools!
sd_guide_s8_tip: When a surprise game patch rolls out (DEFCON 1), Sanctuary warns you before launching and offers to back up your saves & game files automatically!
sd_guide_s9_desc: Customize the look and language of Sanctuary OS however you like, while built-in malware scanning keeps your computer safe from dangerous files.
sd_guide_s9_c1_desc: Pick from Dark and Light themes, download community themes, or design your own with custom wallpapers and glass shine sliders.
sd_guide_s9_c2_desc: Switch the app's wording anytime between Sims-Friendly English, Standard Technical English, Sci-Fi Sanctuary, or Simlish!
sd_guide_s9_c3_desc: Automatically scans .zip, .ts4script, .package, and Python script files against both Global Sanctuary safety rules and game-specific rules.
sd_guide_s9_c4_desc: If a confirmed malware file is caught, Sanctuary moves it out of your Mods folder into Quarantine, locks the screen to protect you, shows why it was flagged, and shreds it when you click Secure Shred.
sd_guide_s9_tip: You can use Sanctuary OS completely offline without an account—and if you're a Verified Creator or Staff member, Passkey security keeps your hub protected!
sd_elevated_role_mason_desc: Every signed-in Simmer can use the local Creator Studio (Sandbox, Code IDE, Theme Builder, Notepad, and Export Release zip/manifest packager). Verified Creators can also publish directly to the Nexus catalog and manage Mod Families!
sd_elevated_role_architect_desc: Help keep the game catalog accurate and friendly! Architects review creator uploads and community Scout submissions, map known mod conflicts, approve config templates, and help players in the Support Desk.
sd_elevated_role_oversight_desc: Manage safety and game updates for the community. Oversight admins add new Game Patches & Expansion Pack IDs, manage malware scanner rules, flag dangerous files, and trigger patch backup alerts.
sd_elevated_role_wayfinder_desc: Own and manage the game community's database! Wayfinders manage staff roles, post news & community polls, set up the 0%-fee Community Tip Jar, manage database keys, and can 'Cut the Cord' anytime.
sd_elevated_role_keeper_desc: Build and maintain the Sanctuary OS app itself, global safety antivirus rules, default language packs & schemas, and help new game communities connect their databases.

sd_roadmap_p2_m2: Automatic Choose-One Flavor swapping & paired Script + Package Twins
sd_roadmap_p2_m3: Automatic required mod checks and safe cascade warnings when removing core mods

sd_roadmap_p3_m2: Built-in Side Browser that automatically installs downloaded .zip and .package files
sd_roadmap_p3_m3: Community Scout submissions and custom local mod names, tags, and cover pictures
sd_roadmap_p4_desc: Added pre-launch conflict checking and the Playtest Lab so Simmers can test new or conflicting mods with a protected test save and live LastException error reader.
sd_roadmap_p4_m1: Severity 1–4 conflict detection and faded warnings for missing packs or outdated mods
sd_roadmap_p4_m2: Playtest Lab that isolates test mods and protects your real household saves
sd_roadmap_p4_m3: Live LastException & crash log reader with plain-English community explanations
sd_roadmap_p5_sub: Instant Save & Game File Backups Using Smart Links
sd_roadmap_p5_desc: Built a super-fast backup system that backs up both your Saves/Tray and your actual Game Installation files using 0 MB of extra drive space for unchanged files.
sd_roadmap_p5_m1: Separate backups for Saves & Tray (World State) and Game Binaries (Engine Core)
sd_roadmap_p5_m2: Smart hardlink technology so unchanged files use 0 MB of extra space
sd_roadmap_p5_m3: Fast full rollback or pick-and-choose single save slot restore

sd_roadmap_p6_desc: Made every word, icon, and glass color in the app customizable with switchable language styles and the interactive Theme Builder.
sd_roadmap_p6_m1: Switch anytime between Sims-Friendly, Standard English, Sci-Fi Sanctuary, and Simlish
sd_roadmap_p6_m2: Interactive Theme Builder with live preview and custom backgrounds
sd_roadmap_p6_m3: Share and install community Themes and Language Packs in one click

sd_roadmap_p7_desc: Turned complicated mod config files into easy sliders and toggles, and unlocked local Creator Studio tools for every player.
sd_roadmap_p7_m1: Visual sliders, toggles, and side-by-side diff viewer for mod config files
sd_roadmap_p7_m2: Open Creator Studio giving all players local Sandbox and IDE tools
sd_roadmap_p7_m3: All-in-one Mod Studio for grouping main mods, script twins, add-ons, and folders

sd_roadmap_p10_m2: Casual 1-click Winner picker + Advanced custom Load Order rules & loop fixer

sd_roadmap_p11_m1: Built-in Rust Malware Scanner checking .zip, .ts4script, .package, and Python scripts

sd_roadmap_p12_m2: Support for multiple game engines, file formats, and load order styles

sd_fork_spoke_hero_badge: OFFICIAL PARTNER COMMUNITY • ZERO CODE EDITS
sd_fork_spoke_hero_title: Connect Your Own Game Community Database in 3 Steps
sd_fork_spoke_hero_desc: Join the official Sanctuary OS game network while owning 100% of your community's Supabase database! You don't need to fork or edit any code.
sd_fork_spoke_step1_title: Step 1: Set Up Your Free Supabase Database (schema.sql)
sd_fork_spoke_step1_desc: Create a free project at supabase.com, open the SQL Editor, and run schema.sql. That one script creates all 36 community tables, security rules, and role settings automatically.
sd_fork_spoke_step2_title: Step 2: Create Your SANCTUARY-UPLINK:// Connection Code
sd_fork_spoke_step2_desc: In Keepers Core -> Active Workspaces (or Wayfinder Hub), paste your Supabase URL, Anon Key, and Service Role Key to create a single SANCTUARY-UPLINK:// connection code.
sd_fork_spoke_step3_title: Step 3: Test Connection & Become Founding Wayfinder
sd_fork_spoke_step3_desc: Click 'Test Connection & Check Database'. Sanctuary checks that your tables are ready and automatically gives your founder account the Wayfinder (Community Manager) role!
sd_fork_arch_hub_desc: Handles single sign-on login, global safety rules, and default schemas. It never holds your community's mods, creators, or play sets hostage.
sd_fork_arch_spoke_desc: 100% owned by your community! Stores all your game's mods, versions, play sets, conflict rules, creator profiles, news posts, and community staff roles.
sd_fork_standalone_hero_badge: STANDALONE APP FORK • EDIT ONLY SRC/SUPABASE.TS
sd_fork_standalone_hero_title: Run Your Own Standalone Copy of Sanctuary OS
sd_fork_standalone_hero_desc: Want to run your own completely separate app—or use your existing community database after clicking Cut the Cord? You only need one Supabase database (schema.sql) and a quick edit in src/supabase.ts!
sd_fork_standalone_s1_title: 1. Works With Just One Database (No Edge Functions Needed)
sd_fork_standalone_s1_desc: When mode is set to 'standalone', Sanctuary OS connects directly to your single Supabase database without needing a separate Hub server or Edge Functions.
sd_fork_standalone_s2_desc: When you sign up the very first account on a fresh standalone database, schema.sql automatically promotes that first account to Wayfinder (Full Admin)!
sd_fork_standalone_s3_title: 3. Everything Works Out of the Box
sd_fork_standalone_s3_desc: All news posts, polls, mod catalogs, creator studios, and support tickets automatically use your single database's tables.
sd_fork_schema_hero_title: Custom Game Schemas & 'Cut the Cord' Anytime
sd_fork_schema_hero_desc: Sanctuary OS uses a simple JSON Game Schema to know where a game's Mods folder is, what file types it uses, and how its load order works—and any community can Cut the Cord anytime.
sd_fork_cord_community_desc: A Community Manager (Wayfinder) can double-click 'Cut the Cord' inside Wayfinder Hub -> Database Connection anytime. This disconnects your community from the main Sanctuary Hub, deletes your service key from the Hub, and leaves 100% of your community database in your hands.
sd_fork_cord_keeper_desc: Sanctuary OS takes 0% of creator Patreon/Ko-fi tips and 0% of community donations. You can copy your SANCTUARY-UPLINK:// code anytime to run your own standalone app.
sd_arch_stack_c1_desc: Built with React 18, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4 featuring customizable 3D frosted Liquid Glass cards and automatic local storage protection.
sd_arch_stack_c2_desc: Handles instant file linking, space-saving hardlink backups, reading game patch versions from .exe files, scanning for malware, and shredding quarantined threats.
sd_arch_stack_c3_desc: Keeps your account email private on the main login server while letting each game community run its own independent mod database and staff roles.
